visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a well-lit office or home study, a woman with short brown hair is sleeping face-down on a light wood desk. She is wearing a pink fuzzy Chiikawa-themed onesie and resting her head on a yellow character pillow. A male hand enters the frame from the bottom right, holding a black smartphone to take several photos of her with the flash on. The desk contains a black computer monitor, a desk lamp, and a white Chiikawa calendar. (2) The camera shifts to a close-up screen recording or perspective of the smartphone. A thumb swipes through the camera roll, displaying various unflattering photos of the woman sleeping at the desk, some with her mouth open. The lighting is bright and even. The background behind the phone is a blurred view of the desk. Large yellow captions appear at the top, and smaller white subtitles with a black background bar appear at the bottom. (3) The scene transitions to an outdoor urban area with gray pavement and green bushes. The woman, now in a black hoodie and denim shorts, walks forward holding a blue Chiikawa umbrella. She purposefully trips and falls flat on the pavement. A phone is immediately brought into the frame to photograph her 'ugly' fall. In subsequent cuts, she poses gracefully on the ground with the umbrella, smiling and making heart gestures with her hands. (4) Located in a park with a playground in the background, the woman sits on a wooden bench wearing a maroon sweater. She holds a small pink fuzzy handbag. She makes a distorted, 'ugly' face for the camera as a phone captures the moment. The camera then cuts to her looking at the phone screen, appearing surprised, before she poses cutely with the pink bag, resting her chin on her hand. (5) In a bright indoor studio with a white sofa and Chiikawa-themed cushions, the woman excitedly presents a variety of merchandise. She displays three fuzzy handbags in pink, yellow, and blue, followed by a light blue folding umbrella and character-themed pillows. She demonstrates the pillows unfolding into blankets by wrapping one around herself while sitting at the desk. The video ends with her standing behind the three bags, spreading her arms wide with a big smile.
